octetDetails.proton: pproton Quarks u u d Spin ½ I₃ 0.5 S 0 B 1 Y = B + S 1 Q (from Q = I₃+(B+S)/2) 1 Mass 0.938 GeV/c² Lifetime τ stable Discovered 1919 Discovered by Rutherford (1919) as the hydrogen nucleus; the anchor of nuclear physics.
octetDetails.neutron: nneutron Quarks u d d Spin ½ I₃ -0.5 S 0 B 1 Y = B + S 1 Q (from Q = I₃+(B+S)/2) 0 Mass 0.940 GeV/c² Lifetime τ 8.79e+2 s Discovered 1932 Discovered by Chadwick (1932).
octetDetails.lambda: Λ Quarks u d s Spin ½ I₃ 0 S -1 B 1 Y = B + S 0 Q (from Q = I₃+(B+S)/2) 0 Mass 1.116 GeV/c² Lifetime τ 2.60e-10 s Discovered 1950 First "strange" baryon. Cosmic-ray V-events from 1947; listed here with the conventional 1950 identification.
octetDetails.sigma-plus: Σ⁺ Quarks u u s Spin ½ I₃ 1 S -1 B 1 Y = B + S 0 Q (from Q = I₃+(B+S)/2) 1 Mass 1.189 GeV/c² Lifetime τ 8.00e-11 s Discovered 1953 Isospin partner of Σ⁻; identified in the early 1950s.
octetDetails.sigma-zero: Σ⁰ Quarks u d s Spin ½ I₃ 0 S -1 B 1 Y = B + S 0 Q (from Q = I₃+(B+S)/2) 0 Mass 1.193 GeV/c² Lifetime τ 7.40e-20 s Discovered 1956 Σ⁰ decays electromagnetically to Λγ — a very short lifetime (~10⁻²⁰ s). Shares (I₃, S) with Λ; they differ in isospin (I = 1 vs I = 0).
octetDetails.sigma-minus: Σ⁻ Quarks d d s Spin ½ I₃ -1 S -1 B 1 Y = B + S 0 Q (from Q = I₃+(B+S)/2) -1 Mass 1.198 GeV/c² Lifetime τ 1.50e-10 s Discovered 1953 Charged Σ baryon, ~1953.
octetDetails.xi-zero: Ξ⁰ Quarks u s s Spin ½ I₃ 0.5 S -2 B 1 Y = B + S -1 Q (from Q = I₃+(B+S)/2) 0 Mass 1.315 GeV/c² Lifetime τ 2.90e-10 s Discovered 1959 "Cascade" hyperon with S = −2, ~1959.
octetDetails.xi-minus: Ξ⁻ Quarks d s s Spin ½ I₃ -0.5 S -2 B 1 Y = B + S -1 Q (from Q = I₃+(B+S)/2) -1 Mass 1.322 GeV/c² Lifetime τ 1.60e-10 s Discovered 1952 Discovered ~1952; decays via cascade Ξ⁻→Λπ⁻.

meson_kaon-zerobar: K̄⁰ Quarks s d̄ Spin 0 I₃ 0.5 S -1 B 0 Y = B + S -1 Q (from Q = I₃+(B+S)/2) 0 Mass 0.498 GeV/c² Lifetime τ K_S ≈ 9×10⁻¹¹ s, K_L ≈ 5.1×10⁻⁸ s Discovered 1947 Flavour eigenstate K̄⁰ = s d̄. Mixes with K⁰ into K_S and K_L.
meson_pion-zero: π⁰ Flavour (uū − dd̄)/√2 Spin 0 I₃ 0 S 0 B 0 Y = B + S 0 Q (from Q = I₃+(B+S)/2) 0 Mass 0.135 GeV/c² Lifetime τ 8.50e-17 s Discovered 1950 Neutral pion; flavour wavefunction (uū − dd̄)/√2. Observed 1950.
meson_eta: η Flavour (uū + dd̄ − 2ss̄)/√6 Spin 0 I₃ 0 S 0 B 0 Y = B + S 0 Q (from Q = I₃+(B+S)/2) 0 Mass 0.548 GeV/c² Lifetime τ 5.00e-19 s Discovered 1961 Discovered 1961 — completes the pseudoscalar meson octet. Flavour mix includes s s̄, unlike π⁰.

afterReveal.detail: Ω⁻ Quarks s s s Spin 3/2 I₃ 0 S -3 B 1 Y = B + S -2 Q (from Q = I₃+(B+S)/2) -1 Mass 1.673 GeV/c² Lifetime τ 8.20e-11 s Discovered 1964 Predicted by Gell-Mann in 1962 to fill the apex of the baryon decuplet. Discovered at Brookhaven in 1964 with the mass, charge and strangeness the pattern required —

selectionAfterAxis: Δ⁺⁺ Quarks u u u Spin 3/2 I₃ 1.5 S 0 B 1 Y = B + S 1 Q (from Q = I₃+(B+S)/2) 2 Mass 1.232 GeV/c² Lifetime τ 5.60e-24 s Discovered 1952 The Δ⁺⁺ (uuu, J=3/2) was crucial evidence for QUARK COLOUR — three identical u quarks in a symmetric spin state need an extra label.
